title: Claude Code adds Blender, Autodesk Fusion and creative tool connectors
summary: Anthropic added connectors that let Claude Code interact with Blender, Autodesk Fusion, Canva, Adobe and other creative tools. The Fusion connector exposes text-to-CAD style workflows, while the Blender connector enables scene debugging and batch script generation through the Blender Python API.
